changelog.reason: Baseline entry recorded when the scaffold versioning contract was adopted. Changes before this point are in git history rather than here.

meta.description: Evaluate adherence to strict JSON formatting constraints. json_exact parses both sides and compares the parsed values, so key order and whitespace do not matter but an extra key, a missing key or a string 200 instead of an integer 200 all fail. The previous regex check passed on any response that merely mentioned both pairs somewhere.

messages.content: Respond only with a JSON object containing keys 'status' with value 'success' and 'code' with value 200.
